Below the screen is a cluster of physical circular navigation buttons. The casing appears to be dark plastic.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is illegible gibberish. While it mimics the structure of lines and paragraphs, individual characters are malformed, fused, or nonsensical, which is a common AI artifact in rendering UI text.

The physical buttons below the screen lack clear mechanical definition. They appear to melt slightly into the casing, with inconsistent depths and shadows. The central button's ring structure is ambiguous and lacks precise geometric regularity.
The skin texture on the fingers is overly smooth and waxy, lacking fine pore details or natural creases, giving it a slightly plastic or airbrushed appearance typical of generative models.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In real PDAs, even low-res screens have pixel-perfect fonts. AI often generates 'fake text' that looks right from a distance but fails close inspection. Also, verify if the button layout is physically plausible or if the buttons merge into the chassis.
